chapter: Discovering jazz and playing in Berlin
title: Record labels and the Berlin jazz club scene at the Eierschale
summary: Records from the books, Johnson records, small groups, Gerhard Kowell, and the Jazz Club Berlin at the Eierschale.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: No, they came out of the book. Where? That was the one who Bill Haley made in 1943. And then the Climax label. And then I bought me also Bank Johnson-Platten. And we had then also small groups. And then there was a couple of people who called it, like Gerhard Kowell.
And then there was a group of people who had a great group. And they were in the Cosa Strasse in Dahlem. And they also had in the Eierschale, in the Jazz-Lokal, and other people had a great group.
That was the Jazz Club Berlin?
Or had the Kowell also a new group?
No, no. It was all in the Eierschale in the club. And they had a lot of the Krach. And then over these meetings, then expanded that knowledge. And then asked others. And then heard the songs more.
